choice: Direction A (Instrument): single 640px column on warm paper, one mono family, latency number as hero, three-value palette.
rationale: Highest independent score (35/45) against the PERSUADE rubric.
Its weakness is a bounded repairable constraint (small-viewport type scaling) while B's is structural genericness.
Hierarchy scored 5: one element carries the composition, which suits a 30-second fit decision.
alternatives: Direction B (Split Ledger) — scored 32; rejected for conventional composition whose distinction rests on a type-family detail.
Direction C (Trace) — scored 28; removed on a productFit blocker (280vh of scroll obscures the install action).
risks: Selection was made from prose, not renders; three of eight rubric dimensions were scored from description.
3-point margin over B is inside noise for this judgment mode.
Repetition stability of this verdict was never measured.
revisitWhen: the hero number exceeds four characters in real usage
a render of A and B exists and can be compared visually
